description: This is a Node.js script that acts as a wrapper to start the Expo development server with normalized host options, a fixed port, and a health check server. It manages command-line arguments, environment variables, and ensures the server's readiness signaling.

methods.name: startHealthcheckServer(port, path)
methods.description: Creates and starts a minimal HTTP server on the specified port to serve health check responses, handling binding errors gracefully.

methods.name: resolveHostMode()
methods.description: Determines the host mode ('lan', 'tunnel', or 'localhost') based on environment variables and input, with prioritized logic.

methods.name: sanitizeIncomingArgs(argv)
methods.description: Removes conflicting or unsupported command-line flags from the input arguments to prevent clashes with the script's own options.

methods.name: buildArgs()
methods.description: Constructs and returns the array of CLI arguments to properly start the expo server with normalized parameters.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Main entry point that starts the health check server, sanitizes inputs, builds CLI args, and spawns the expo start process.
